ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) Safe-Mode Boot Reconfiguration Prior to Encryption (T1562.009)
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin/Agenda ransomware hallmark of using bcdedit.exe to flip the host into safe-mode (minimal or network) so that EDR/AV services don't start, then reboot and encrypt. Qilin's Rust/Go binaries are documented (Microsoft Threat Intelligence, Sophos X-Ops, Group-IB) to chain `bcdedit /set safeboot ...` -> shadow-copy deletion -> reboot -> encrypt — a tradecraft pattern that almost no other ransomware family (besides REvil/Snatch derivatives) employs and that is core to the Qilin affiliate playbook.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=outer dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count as recovery_ops values(Processes.process) as recovery_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN (vssadmin.exe, wmic.exe, wbadmin.exe, shutdown.exe) AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*shutdown*/r*")) earliest=-10m@m latest=now() by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where isnotnull(recovery_ops) AND recovery_ops>=1 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SafeBootEdit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot", "bootstatuspolicy", "recoveryenabled")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/set", "-set")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SafeBootParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let RecoveryNuke = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","shutdown.exe","powershell.exe","cipher.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog -quiet","shutdown /r","shutdown -r","Remove-WmiObject -Class Win32_ShadowCopy","/w")
    | project RecoveryTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
SafeBootEdit
| join kind=inner RecoveryNuke on DeviceId
| where RecoveryTime between (SafeBootTime - WindowMinutes .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize SafeBootCmd = any(SafeBootCmd), SafeBootParent = any(SafeBootParent),
            RecoveryCmds = make_set(RecoveryCmd, 10), HitCount = count()
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(SafeBootTime, 1h)
| where HitCount >= 1
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SafeBootEdit = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("safeboot","bootstatuspolicy","recoveryenabled")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/set","-set")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              SafeBootCmd = CommandLine, SafeBootParent = ParentProcessName;
let RecoveryNuke = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\vssadmin.exe","\\wmic.exe","\\wbadmin.exe","\\shutdown.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\cipher.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog -quiet","shutdown /r","shutdown -r","Remove-WmiObject -Class Win32_ShadowCopy")
    | project RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RecoveryCmd = CommandLine;
SafeBootEdit
| join kind=inner RecoveryNuke on Computer
| where RecoveryTime between (SafeBootTime - WindowMinutes .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize SafeBootCmd = any(SafeBootCmd), SafeBootParent = any(SafeBootParent),
            RecoveryCmds = make_set(RecoveryCmd, 10), HitCount = count()
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(SafeBootTime, 1h)
| order by SafeBootTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin Linux/ESXi Affiliate Mass VM Termination via esxcli Before VMDK Encryption (T1489)
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin Linux/ESXi variant's signature pre-encryption step: SSH into ESXi hypervisors, enumerate running VMs with `esxcli vm process list`, then force-kill every world ID with `esxcli vm process kill --type=force --world-id=N`, freeing VMDK locks so the Rust encryptor can blast them. This bulk-kill loop is documented across Trend Micro / Sygnia / Group-IB Qilin IR reports and is a Qilin/Agenda fingerprint distinct from RansomHub / Akira ESXi behaviour (which prefer `vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off`).
ucs.splunk:
index=esxi OR index=vmware OR sourcetype IN ("vmware:esxlog:shell.log","vmware:esxlog:hostd.log","vmware:esxlog:auth.log","syslog") ("esxcli vm process kill" "--type=force")
| rex field=_raw "--world-id=(?<world_id>\d+)"
| rex field=_raw "user=(?<actor_user>\S+)"
| rex field=_raw "(?i)from\s+(?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})"
| stats dc(world_id) as VMsKilled min(_time) as firstKill max(_time) as lastKill values(actor_user) as users values(src_ip) as src_ips values(_raw) as sample_events by host
| eval window_minutes = round((lastKill-firstKill)/60, 1)
| where VMsKilled >= 5 AND window_minutes <= 15
| convert ctime(firstKill) ctime(lastKill)
| sort - lastKill
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let BurstWindow = 15m;
let KillThreshold = 5;
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where Facility in ("user","auth","authpriv","daemon","local4")
| where SyslogMessage has "esxcli" and SyslogMessage has "vm process kill" and SyslogMessage has "--type=force"
| extend WorldId = extract(@"--world-id=(\d+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend ActorUser = extract(@"(?i)user=(\S+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend SrcIp = extract(@"(?i)from\s+(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})", 1, SyslogMessage)
| where isnotempty(WorldId)
| summarize VMsKilled = dcount(WorldId),
            FirstKill = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastKill = max(TimeGenerated),
            Users = make_set(ActorUser, 5),
            SrcIps = make_set(SrcIp, 5),
            Sample = make_set(SyslogMessage, 5)
            by Computer, HostIP, bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| where VMsKilled >= KillThreshold
| extend BurstDuration = LastKill - FirstKill
| order by LastKill desc
